bug_semantics: GET /local_repo/structure takes a caller-supplied filesystem path query parameter and walks it with os.walk, returning the relative file tree and README contents. The handler does not confine the path to a repository root, reject absolute paths, or require authentication; WIKI_AUTH_MODE defaults to false, so an unauthenticated remote caller can list arbitrary host directories.
flaw_origin: Original feature implementation. Commit 88b21921898b4be30f695882ce8c8ab712d905d9 ('feat: Add local folder support') first added @app.get("/local_repo/structure") in api/api.py, taking Query path and walking it with os.walk(path) with only hidden-dir/venv filters. Later 6784cb22a7b312e39e6a07457469aef0d037bbd1 reformatted the same handler and b5e766699b7f0ec5294426af53f5924d9058218b moved it to api/routers/wiki.py without adding path confinement or auth on this route.
evidence: First-party GHSA-xj74-834m-p9pc / CVE-2026-72602 (CVE.org state PUBLISHED, dateRejected null, GHSA withdrawn_at null) describe unauthenticated directory listing via the local-repository structure endpoint through commit 16f35a0; CWE-22, CVSS 7.5.

git log -S 'local_repo/structure' --pretty='%H %s' reports first addition at 88b21921898b4be30f695882ce8c8ab712d905d9; later hits 6784cb22a7b312e39e6a07457469aef0d037bbd1 (cleanup/reformat), 209e59af5cfb113250f3bb3fcbc4eb5d4ab5f36c (Next.js proxy, not a path confinement), and b5e766699b7f0ec5294426af53f5924d9058218b (move api/api.py -> api/routers/wiki.py).

git show --stat 88b21921898b4be30f695882ce8c8ab712d905d9 -- api/api.py is 52 insertions / 2 deletions on an existing file. The added handler is @app.get("/local_repo/structure") with path: str = Query(...), os.path.isdir(path), then os.walk(path) emitting rel_file paths and README text. No realpath, commonpath, allowed-root, or auth check is present in that hunk.

HEAD still contains the same sink: api/routers/wiki.py get_local_repo_structure still Query-accepts path and os.walk(path). git grep on HEAD for realpath/allowed_root/is_relative_to/commonpath in that router is empty. WIKI_AUTH_MODE is imported and used on other wiki-cache routes but not this handler; api/config.py still defaults DEEPWIKI_AUTH_MODE to False. No commit after 16f35a0fc0284e99b7963bbf4e8585e9957e2fe1 closes the listing path.
